text: dsh-maxcompute 是连接 DSH 与 MaxCompute（ODPS）的数据分析插件，通过 maxc 命令行接入表格元数据和 SQL 能力。它可列出表、查看结构与分区、预览样本，并先估算扫描成本再执行查询。查询也能作为后台任务运行，之后查看状态、获取或导出结果。默认配置启用只读限制和扫描量阈值。使用需安装 maxc，认证由 maxc 管理。

dsh-maxcompute connects DSH to MaxCompute via maxc. It browses tables, schemas, and partitions; previews rows; estimates SQL cost; and runs queries. Background jobs can be tracked, with results retrieved or exported. Read-only and scan limits are enabled by default. Install maxc for authentication.
想在 DSH 里查看 MaxCompute 项目有哪些表以及表结构。
I want to inspect partitions and preview a few rows from an ODPS table inside DSH.
能不能先估算 SQL 扫描量，再把查询交给后台运行并稍后取回结果？
dsh-maxcompute 的功能「浏览表元数据」：在 DSH 工具调用中列出项目表、按名称前缀筛选、查看列与分区列，并列出分区或预览有限行数的样本。
dsh-maxcompute 的功能「运行和跟踪 SQL 任务」：调用查询工具估算扫描成本并执行 SQL，也可提交后台任务；随后查询任务状态、取回结果、取消任务或将结果导出为文件。
dsh-maxcompute 使用 maxc 命令行访问 MaxCompute；认证状态由 maxc 自身管理，插件不直接接触凭证。

dsh-maxcompute README · dsh-maxcompute：[MaxCompute (ODPS)](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/maxcompute) data analysis plugin for [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh): metadata browsing, cost-gated SQL execution, background jobs and result export — all backed by the [`maxc`](https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-odps-console) CLI.

dsh-maxcompute README · Architecture：```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  maxcompute-tools (consumer)                        │
│  9 model-facing tools + readonly guard + cost gate  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

Auth lives in maxc's own config — this plugin never sees credentials.

```

dsh-maxcompute README · Install：```bash
npm install dsh-maxcompute
```

DSH reads the `dsh.bundle.patch` field in `package.json` and loads [cordis.patch.yml](./cordis.patch.yml), which wires the three layers. Each row can be replaced by id from a later patch layer (profile / home / `--patch` overlay).

dsh-maxcompute README · Configuration：| Layer | Key | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|-----|------|---------|-------------|
| `maxcompute-maxc` | `maxcBin` | string | `maxc` | Path to the maxc binary |
| `maxcompute-maxc` | `project` | string | — | Default project override (`--project`) |
| `maxcompute-maxc` | `timeoutMs` | number | `600000` | Kill a foreground maxc process after this many ms |
| `maxcompute-tools` | `readonly` | boolean | `true` | Deny DDL/DML/SET/TUNNEL at the guard layer |
| `maxcompute-tools` | `dryRunScanGBThreshold` | number | `10` | Refuse `mc_run_sql` when estimated scan exceeds this |
| `maxcompute-tools` | `maxPreviewRows` | number | `50` | Default row cap for previews returned to the model |
dsh-maxcompute README · Configuration：The readonly guard is **monotonic**: once enabled it cannot be re-allowed by later listeners.

dsh-maxcompute README · Tools：| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `mc_list_tables` | List tables in a project, optional prefix filter |
| `mc_describe_table` | Column schema, partition columns, size, comment |
| `mc_list_partitions` | List partition values for a partitioned table |
| `mc_sample_table` | Row-limited preview (always safe) |
| `mc_explain_sql` | Dry-run cost estimate — call before expensive queries |
| `mc_run_sql` | Execute SQL (readonly guard + cost gate) |
| `mc_job_status` | Poll an async job's state / progress / logview |
| `mc_job_result` | Fetch results, optionally export to file |
| `mc_job_cancel` | Cancel a running job |

dsh-maxcompute README · Example session：```
User:    帮我看看 odps_demo 项目里有哪些表
Model:   → mc_list_tables(project="odps_demo")
         found 42 tables: dwd_trade_detail, dws_user_profile, ...

dsh-maxcompute README · Replacing the provider：To swap maxc for an in-house gateway, create a patch layer that re-inserts row id `maxcompute-maxc` with your own module providing the same `maxcompute` service. The tools layer depends only on the service contract from `maxcompute-core`.
